children.value: > Fact From Story: In practice it’s the opposite: it’s a truly free market approach to social networking.
> > Fact From Story: Mastodon may not be interested in becoming a trillion-dollar company, but there’s no reason there can’t be plenty of those built on the fediverse.
> > > Fact From Story: The only way to win is to build the best product.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Competition leads to the creation of new and better products.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A free market increases competition.
> Fact From Story: In a sentence, the fediverse is an interconnected set of apps that can all read and write the same content.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A free market is where anyone can offer anything for sale.
